summary: Your fourth teach-back. You write what you know, explain attention with an analogy of your own in 5 sentences or a voice note, check six key points, and run one attention step by hand in plain Python to see weights that add up to one and move when the question changes.
goal: Explain attention in 5 sentences with an analogy of your own, and show the weights with a small experiment.

items.text: Write what it refers to in the cable sentence, how you knew, and how a model might know
Explain attention with your own analogy in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note, without notes
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run attention.py, then change the query and see a different word win
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and improve your analogy
Play the Attention Match game to the end and see your score
